messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "tell doctor if have or have ever had kidney or pancreas disease"
set: ["tell doctor if have or have ever had kidney or pancreas disease", "tell your doctor if you have ever had liver or kidney disease", "tell doctor if ever had kidney disease", "tell doctor if have or had kidney problems", "tell doctor if have or had pregnancy", "tell your doctor if you have ever had diabetes", "tell your doctor if you have ever had anemia", "tell your doctor if you have ever had thyroiditis", "tell doctor if have or had seizures or epilepsy", "tell doctor if have or had liver problems", "tell doctor if have or had heart problems", "tell doctor if ever had liver disease or liver impairment", "tell doctor if have or had bleeding problems", "tell your doctor if you have ever had heart problems", "tell your doctor if you have ever had thyroid nodule", "tell doctor if have or had bipolar disorder or mania"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
